name: cc-cold-cache-guard
description: Holds prompts sent to a session whose prompt cache has gone cold, and offers a cheap handoff (summarized by a local LLM or a small Claude model) instead of an expensive full cache write.

provider.title: Handoff provider
provider.description: Who summarizes the handoff: Claude through this session's API (anthropic) or a local OpenAI-compatible server such as LM Studio (local). Default: anthropic.

anthropic_model.title: Claude model
anthropic_model.description: Anthropic provider only. An alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id. Default: haiku.

anthropic_effort.title: Claude effort
anthropic_effort.description: Anthropic provider only. Ignored by models without an effort setting, including Haiku 4.5. Default: low.

auto_continue_choice.title: Auto-continue choice
auto_continue_choice.description: Add a cold-cache option that generates the handoff, runs /clear and sends it right away. Default: off.

idle_minutes.title: Idle threshold (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: Minutes of idleness before a prompt is held. auto = the cache TTL detected from the transcript minus the margin below. Default: auto.

auto_margin_minutes.title: Auto margin (minutes)
auto_margin_minutes.description: With idle_minutes auto: how many minutes before the cache TTL to start holding prompts. Default: 2.

fallback_ttl_minutes.title: Fallback cache TTL (minutes)
fallback_ttl_minutes.description: Cache TTL assumed when the transcript doesn't show one. Default: 60.

llm_base_url.title: Local server URL
llm_base_url.description: Local provider only. Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server. Default: http://localhost:1234.

model.title: Local model
model.description: Local provider only. Default: empty, which uses the first loaded model.

temperature.title: Local temperature
temperature.description: Local provider only. Sampling temperature. Default: 0.2.

local_thinking.title: Local model thinking
local_thinking.description: Local provider only. Let a reasoning model think before writing the handoff. Thinking is slow and spends output tokens, and a handoff rarely needs it. Default: off.

request_timeout_seconds.title: Request timeout (seconds)
request_timeout_seconds.description: Limit for the summarizing call; must stay below the hooks module's 10-minute limit. Default: 540.

max_output_tokens.title: Max handoff tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Output cap for the handoff. Anthropic caps it at 64000. Default: 16384.

max_transcript_chars.title: Max transcript characters
max_transcript_chars.description: How much of the condensed transcript is sent to the summarizer. Sized for a 200k-token context; a value that won't fit the model makes the handoff unavailable and says what would. Default: 620000 (about 177k tokens).

handoff_dir.title: Handoff folder
handoff_dir.description: Where handoff files are saved. Default: ~/.claude/handoffs.
